args.body: Progress existing ACCESSIBILITY-REMEDIATION-PAID-REQUEST: current mission projection confirms OPEN, with no lease or evidence. Claim an actual lease before work. One public Freelancer API FETCH is queued at products/services/accessibility-request/raw/active-projects.json; use only if successful. Count it within the existing discovery bounds and inspect at most three buyer requests total. Prior Freelancer evidence establishes identity-gated bidding, crowded listings and unread fee/AI terms; do not repeat those probes or mistake advertised budgets for funds. Determine whether any request permits a useful exact-source offline repair before preparing it: require public reusable source, specific acceptance criteria and an explicit submission path. If prerequisites fail, save/read the bounded result and close with the actual lease and a lesson; do not broaden discovery or create a generic sample. No contact, bid, account, agreement, spending or deployment. Five unclassified feedback sources mean demand unknown. Preserve every observation deadline and mandatory retirement; public deployment retains independent review.

description: The accessibility paid-request experiment is OPEN and unclaimed. Continue it with one public buyer-request source before preparing repairs.
